name: react-native-best-practices
headline: Cursor Anthropic Skills Integration Framework
short_description: The cursor-anthropic-skills framework integrates Anthropic Skills into Cursor IDE, helping AI agents to use specialized knowledge and domain expertise for precise user interactions. This ensures enhanced responsiveness and accuracy in various applications.
author: SteelMorgan

sections.overview:
cursor-anthropic-skills is a framework that extends Cursor IDE with dynamic skill loading capabilities. It solves Cursor's limitation of not supporting multiple agents simultaneously by implementing a prompt-based mechanism that analyzes user requests, consults a centralized skill index, and automatically loads relevant domain knowledge. The system uses semantic analysis and keyword matching to identify appropriate skills, then applies best practices and specialized knowledge to user queries. This approach allows AI agents to access expertise across technologies including 1C/BSL, Docker, PowerShell, Go, testing frameworks, and more without requiring manual context switching.
Enhancing code suggestions with domain-specific knowledge
Automating repetitive coding tasks
Providing context-aware debugging assistance
Facilitating collaborative coding sessions
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
